heroSub: 5 hand-picked stays around Laem Chabang, Thung Sukhla and Si Racha that we've reviewed in depth — a boutique hotel with a pool, a roomy city hotel, a residence near Kasetsart University, and an apartment that takes monthly stays. Every one is near the port and the Laem Chabang industrial estate. From around ฿545–654/night.
introH2: ⚓ What kinds of stays are there in Laem Chabang, and how do you pick the right one?
introHtml: Laem Chabang isn't a beach-holiday district, and that's the first thing to get straight before you book — most people who stay around here come for "work reasons" rather than a holiday: meetings at the Laem Chabang industrial estate, port business, site visits, visiting a student at Kasetsart University Si Racha, or an overnight stop before heading on to Pattaya or Rayong. So the stays around Thung Sukhla and Si Racha come in several forms: some are boutique hotels with a pool to soak in after work, some are roomy city hotels with their own meeting rooms, some are residences with a fridge and a desk that suit a long working stay, and some are budget apartments that take monthly bookings. Plenty of people book a hotel around here and end up disappointed because they expected a sea view or a pool that isn't there. This article rounds up 5 Laem Chabang stays we've reviewed in depth — each one drawn from reading real guest reviews, with the upsides and the honest caveats, prices compared across 3 sites, and direct booking links throughout, so you can pick the stay that actually matches your reason for coming.
mrtHtml: Laem Chabang and Si Racha have no rail line, and public transport in the industrial district doesn't run often, so driving yourself is by far the easiest option — every stay in this article has free parking. If you don't have a car, plan ahead for ride-hailing apps, which can be harder to catch here than in town at some hours, or fall back on the stay's restaurant and room service. The areas covered here: Thung Sukhla · Si Racha — near the Laem Chabang port, the industrial estate, and Space Inspirium (the space innovation park), a few minutes' drive away. Ao Udom — the side near Kasetsart University Si Racha and the Ao Udom night market, a favourite food spot for locals here. Driving from Bangkok via the motorway or Sukhumvit Road takes around an hour and a half to two hours. Pattaya beach is around a 20–30 min drive for anyone who wants to add on a seaside trip.

entries.name: Avana Laemchabang Boutique Hotel
entries.badge: 🏊 Has a pool · Highest star rating in the set
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thung Sukhla · Si Racha · Near the port + estate
entries.addr: 114/99 Soi Laem Thong 2, Moo 10 · Thung Sukhla · Si Racha
entries.storyHtml: Among the Laem Chabang stays that start in the several-hundred-baht range, what pushes Avana Laemchabang Boutique Hotel to the top of this set is that it gives you 4-star facilities at budget-hotel prices — a roughly 100-room boutique hotel, open since around 2013, on Soi Laem Thong 2 in Thung Sukhla, Si Racha. What clearly sets Avana apart from rivals in the same area is that it has a real outdoor saltwater pool plus a kids' pool, which is hard to find in hotels starting in the hundreds around here. Several real reviews praise the pool as clean and a good spot to unwind after work, and families travelling with kids feel more at ease thanks to the separate kids' pool. Beyond the pool there's a gym, the Avana Cafe restaurant serving a buffet breakfast that many call filling and good value, a bar, and a Thai and aroma massage spa — all in one place. The rooms keep things simple and contemporary; the points reviewers agree on are that the rooms are larger than the price suggests and the water pressure in the bathroom is good. Main room types run from the Premier Single up to the Executive at around 28 sq.m. and the Junior Suite. Service is another point that earns steady praise — staff are warm, friendly, and helpful. Honest caveats from the reviews: the location is down a deep soi that's hard to find the first time, so without GPS or asking a local you'll struggle; some rooms and parts of the building look older than in the promo photos; a few reviews mention loose power sockets and poor sound insulation between rooms; and the restaurant focuses mainly on breakfast, with limited dinner options on-site. In short, if you're coming to work around Laem Chabang and want a stay with a pool to relax in on a budget you can still manage, Avana is the best-value pick in this set.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: turn on GPS and save the location before you come, because Soi Laem Thong 2 is fairly deep and hard to find the first time, especially if you arrive at night. Some Premier Single rooms have no window — if you want natural light, say so and ask when you book. And don't miss the pool and the buffet breakfast that reviews praise so often.

Rooms are larger and cleaner than the price, comfy beds, good water pressure
Filling, good-value buffet breakfast, with a gym and spa on-site
Warm, friendly staff, free parking, near the port and the estate
cons: Down a deep soi, hard to find the first time — turn on GPS to navigate

entries.name: Laemchabang City Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thung Sukhla · 2.7 km from the port + estate
entries.addr: 53/325 Moo 9 · Thung Sukhla · Laem Chabang · Si Racha
entries.storyHtml: If Avana sells the pool, Laemchabang City Hotel sells size and the feel of a city hotel built to handle work — a 3.5-star, 6-storey hotel with up to 128 rooms, the biggest in this set, in Thung Sukhla, Si Racha, in an area ringed by the Laem Chabang port and the industrial estate. What draws people to stay here is the location — around 2.7 km from the Laem Chabang industrial estate and around 2.4 km from Space Inspirium, a few minutes' drive away — and on Trip.com the location category scores as high as around 9.4, pulling the overall score up to 9.1. What a lot of reviews agree on is that the rooms are larger than expected for the price, clean, and the beds are comfy. The most-booked rooms are the Deluxe Double and Deluxe Twin at around 24 sq.m., mostly on floors 5–6, stepping up to the Premier Room and Junior Suite. An advantage for business guests is the business centre and meeting room, suited to small-to-mid-size seminars, which leads many companies to use it as team lodging and run their meetings on-site, plus the free, spacious parking that reviews mention often — handy when a team arrives in several cars. Honest caveats: there's no pool here — it's a city hotel, not a leisure resort; breakfast at the Sweet Lemon restaurant is fairly limited; service at the desk isn't always smooth; some furniture is starting to show its age; and this is an industrial zone where the main road carries trucks. In short, it suits people coming to Laem Chabang for work — port and estate business, or arriving as a team — who want clean, roomy rooms with a meeting room at a good-value price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if you're a light or noise-sensitive sleeper, ask for a high floor (5–6) and a room not facing the main road where trucks pass. Breakfast is limited, so plan to eat out at the many spots around the hotel. And if you're arriving as a team or running a meeting, contact the hotel about the meeting room and group rates in advance to get a better deal.

High location score around 9.4, near the port, estate, and Space Inspirium

Free, spacious parking, 24-hour desk, flexible check-in
cons: No pool, not suited to a holiday getaway
Limited breakfast options · service at the desk isn't always smooth (from reviews)
Industrial area, trucks pass on the main road · some furniture is starting to age

entries.name: Grand Marina Residence Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ao Udom · 4–5 min to Kasetsart Uni Si Racha
tags: 🧊 Every room has a fridge + desk
entries.addr: 224/65 Moo 8, Soi Sawatdi · Thung Sukhla · Si Racha
entries.storyHtml: Grand Marina Residence Hotel sits between a hotel and an apartment — you get the convenience of a hotel with a reception desk and staff on hand, plus the spaciousness of a residence-style room with a fridge and a desk you'll actually use. It's a small hotel of around 25 rooms on Soi Sawatdi in Thung Sukhla, on the Ao Udom side of Laem Chabang, scoring 8.5 from 48 reviews on Trip.com, with its top category being service at around 9.0 — something reviews bring up a lot, saying the reception staff are friendly, smiling, and helpful, recommending restaurants, giving directions, and sorting out parking. The strength of the location is being within easy reach of everything you need — the Ao Udom night market around 1 km away, a 7-Eleven and made-to-order restaurants within walking distance, and around a 4–5 minute drive to Kasetsart University, Si Racha campus, making it a good base for parents visiting a student. Many reviews agree the rooms are larger than the price; every room has a fridge, a work desk, and a kettle, and some have an in-room dining table, with comfy beds and good cold air-con. There's a pool, gym, ping-pong table, bike rental, and free parking with an EV charging point, which isn't common at this price level. Honest caveats from the reviews: a few note that at times the pool's condition or opening hours don't match the promo photos, so if you mean to use the pool, call the hotel (038-352226) before booking; this area suits people with a car since public transport is sparse; it's an alcohol-free area with no bar; and it's an industrial-town area with no sea view. In short, it suits people working at the estate who want a semi-residential stay, parents visiting a student, and anyone looking for a good-value overnight in this area.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if you mean to use the pool, call the hotel (038-352226) before booking to check it's open as normal during your dates, since reviews have flagged this. Make the most of the residence-style room by stopping at the Ao Udom night market or 7-Eleven to stock the fridge — a big saving on a long working stay.

entries.name: NYTH Hotel - Laem Chabang Seaport
entries.badge: 🧼 Most reviews in the set · Ozone cleaning
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thung Sukhla · Si Racha · Near the port + estate
tags: 🛏️ Minimalist rooms that look better than the price
entries.addr: 99/99 Moo 9, Nong Rae Rd · Thung Sukhla · Si Racha
entries.storyHtml: In this set of Laem Chabang stays, if you measure by sheer number of reviews, NYTH Hotel - Laem Chabang Seaport is the one with the most — over 402 reviews on Agoda, scoring 8.0, and 8.4 on Trip.com. It's a small 3-star boutique hotel of around 50 rooms in Thung Sukhla, Si Racha, that pitches itself as a "chic hotel" near the port, focused on clean, good-looking rooms, easy prices, and quiet. Prices start at ฿545/night, the cheapest per night in this set, making it the easy-on-the-wallet pick for anyone who just needs one good night's sleep. The point many people agree on is the contemporary minimalist rooms, which look cleaner and more designed than the usual budget hotel. Main rooms split into the Economy King and the Superior King at around 24 sq.m., and what the hotel highlights as a selling point is its ozone room-cleaning service, which helps with cleanliness and odour — a point where many feel they get more care than what they pay. Most real reviews praise the rooms as clean, the beds as comfy, and the place as very quiet for an undisturbed night, with friendly staff and a location near workplaces at the estate, just a few minutes' drive away. An honest caveat that needs stating plainly: the most-discussed point is that there's no pool in service anymore, even though some listings still say there is — if that matters to you, confirm with the hotel first. After that, parts of the building and some rooms are starting to age and cleanliness standards may not be consistent in every room; the location is fairly quiet and around 500 m from restaurants; and there have been cases of the price charged at the desk differing from online. In short, it suits people coming for work or stopping over for one night who want a clean, quiet room with easy parking at the lowest price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: book through the online platforms and keep proof of the confirmed price, because past reviews mention the desk price differing from online. Don't count on a pool — there's none in service anymore, even if some listings still say there is. The location is quiet and around 500 m from restaurants, so if you don't have a car, plan to use the hotel's restaurant and room service.

Minimalist rooms that look better than the price, cleaned with an ozone system
Very quiet for easy sleep, good for people working at the estate
Friendly staff, free parking, free Wi-Fi, near the port and the estate
cons: No pool in service anymore (some listings still say there is) · not by the sea
Parts of the building and some rooms are starting to age, cleanliness isn't consistent in every room

entries.name: Basaya Laemchabang
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Thung Sukhla · Si Racha · Near the port + estate
tags: 🛏️ Superior rooms roomier than the price
entries.storyHtml: Basaya Laemchabang is the most budget pick in this set in terms of star rating — a 2-star apartment and budget stay of around 45 rooms in Thung Sukhla, Si Racha, taking both daily and monthly bookings. Although the number of online reviews is still small (around 21 on Trip.com), the score is as high as 9.0, with the value category reaching around 9.1 and room size around 9.0, which reflects this place's main selling point exactly. The point many people agree on is that the rooms are roomier than what you pay. Main rooms are Superior, with a choice of one double bed or two single beds, and every room has a fridge, coffee maker, safe, and satellite TV — which, for a stay at this price, is more in-room kit than you'd expect. The building has a lift, a restaurant and coffee shop on-site, a billiard room to hang out in during the evening, a 24-hour reception desk, free Wi-Fi that reviews say is strong and smooth, and free parking. The monthly rate, much cheaper per night, makes this especially appealing for staff on a long-term posting at the estate. Honest caveats from the reviews: the building is near a main road, so there's some traffic noise, especially in rooms facing the road; there's no pool and it's not by the sea; restaurants aren't right out front, so you'll head to the Ao Udom night market around 1.2 km away; and some of the building and furniture is starting to age — and with the still-small number of reviews, it's worth reading the latest ones alongside. In short, it suits people coming for work or looking for a monthly stay who want a roomy, clean room with full in-room kit at the lowest price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask for a room not facing the road, or a high floor, right when you book, because the building is near a main road and there's some traffic noise at times. For a long stay, ask the property directly about the monthly rate, which is much cheaper per night. For food, head to the Ao Udom night market around 1.2 km away, with made-to-order dishes at local prices.

faqTitle: FAQ — Common Traveller Questions About Laem Chabang Stays, Chonburi

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best Laem Chabang stay?
faq.a: It depends on your reason for coming · if you want a stay with a pool on a budget, Avana Laemchabang Boutique Hotel is the only 4-star in the set with a saltwater pool, kids' pool, and spa · if you're coming as a team or running a meeting, Laemchabang City Hotel has 128 rooms and a meeting room on-site, with a high location score of around 9.4 · for a long working stay or visiting Kasetsart Uni, Grand Marina Residence · if you want a clean, quiet room at the lowest price per night, NYTH Hotel has the most reviews at over 402 · and for a monthly stay, Basaya Laemchabang.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Laem Chabang stays cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at around ฿545–654 per night for a standard room · cheapest per night is NYTH Hotel from ฿545 · Basaya from ฿650 · Avana from ฿654 · while Laemchabang City Hotel and Grand Marina Residence start at around ฿750 · prices rise during estate events or projects, and higher room types like the Executive or Junior Suite run around ฿1,000–1,500 · we recommend comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com before every booking.

faq.q: ❓ Which Laem Chabang stays have a pool?
faq.a: In this set, Avana Laemchabang Boutique Hotel has a confirmed-working outdoor saltwater pool plus a kids' pool · Grand Marina Residence has a pool too, but reviews flag that at times its condition or opening hours don't match the promo photos, so call to check before booking · while Laemchabang City Hotel, NYTH Hotel, and Basaya have no pool (NYTH once had one but no longer keeps it open, even though some listings still say there is) · if the pool matters, go with Avana or confirm directly with the property before booking.

faq.q: ❓ How do you get around Laem Chabang — do you need a car?
faq.a: Laem Chabang and Si Racha have no rail line, and public transport in the industrial district doesn't run often, so driving yourself is by far the easiest option — every stay in this article has free parking · driving from Bangkok via the motorway or Sukhumvit Road takes around an hour and a half to two hours · if you don't have a car, plan ahead for ride-hailing apps, which can be harder to catch here than in town at some hours, or use the stay's restaurant and room service, and check that ride-hailing reaches the area before you travel.

faq.q: ❓ Visiting Pattaya and the sea — should you stay in Laem Chabang?
faq.a: If your main aim is the sea and relaxing by the beach, we don't recommend staying in Laem Chabang, since it's an industrial and port district with no beachfront stays or sea views · Pattaya beach is around a 20–30 minute drive from Laem Chabang, so consider staying on the Bang Saen or Pattaya side, which have beachfront resorts instead · but if you're here for work, port and estate business, or visiting Kasetsart Uni Si Racha, the stays in this set meet the need well and are far better value.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should you book a Laem Chabang stay?
faq.a: Many stays in this area are small (around 25–100 rooms) and have regular guests working at the estate, so they fill up fast during estate events or projects, activities at Kasetsart Uni, or corporate seminars — book ahead and compare prices across several platforms · in normal periods, 1–2 weeks ahead is enough · every platform offers Free Cancellation, so we recommend locking in a rate like that first if your plans aren't set, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price.
